text: Onions and garlic are essential ingredients in many cuisines, adding depth and flavor to dishes such as stir-fries, omelets, and casseroles. When sautéed in small pieces, they can be cooked in a matter of minutes to an hour, depending on the desired level of caramelization and the dish being prepared. These versatile aromatics are commonly sautéed in small pieces to enhance their natural sweetness and create a robust flavor profile. Whether you're preparing a hearty bowl of soup, a rich and savory stew, or a simple sautéed vegetable dish, the addition of onions and garlic can elevate the entire meal. Their ability to absorb and blend flavors makes them a fundamental component in many recipes, ensuring a satisfying and aromatic culinary experience.
